//: Block loot tables in the behavior-pack loot-table schema. BDS 1.26.51 ships no loot tables for these blocks (their drops are built into the server), so these are authored from the Java Edition vanilla tables with Bedrock identifiers until a BDS drop sweep replaces them. Extensions beyond the Bedrock schema, all with Java semantics: entry type 'alternatives' (first child whose conditions pass), function 'apply_bonus' (ore_drops / uniform_bonus_count / binomial_with_bonus_count), function 'limit_count', count provider {type: binomial, n, p}, conditions 'table_bonus', 'block_state_property' and 'inverted'. Blocks absent here drop their own item; blocks that require the correct tool drop nothing without it.
